research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document came straight from the bank's own CMS https://kms.boiindonesia.co.id/storage/documents/1/... (links read from the __NEXT_DATA__ JSON of the Next.js IR pages under https://boiindonesia.co.id/id/category/hubungan-dengan-investor/, saved in html/). Plain curl with a browser User-Agent on 2026-11-03, no bot challenge (www.boiindonesia.co.id answers 403; the bare domain works). No Internet Archive copy was needed. idx.co.id was not used. News (pasardana/kontan, via web search) only for the Oct-2026 trading suspensions, which are not data in this file.

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank of India Indonesia Tbk (formerly PT Bank Swadesi Tbk; renamed 2011; Bank of India - owned by the Government of India - holds 90.96% since PUT V, PT Panca Mantra Jaya 4.99% at the Jun-2025 AGMS; free float 7.68% at 31 Mar 2026 per news, free-float deadline 31 Mar 2029 per the Oct-2026 incidental public expose). The bank has no subsidiaries, associates or JVs (AR2025 PDF p. 33); its audited 'Laporan Keuangan' are the whole entity. Money fields carry basis 'consolidated' (validator rule), ratios 'bank_only' as printed. equity_attr = total_equity (no NCI). Conventional bank, no sharia unit. Auditors: Tanubrata Sutanto Fahmi Bambang & Rekan (BDO) for FY2021-FY2022, Kanaka Puradiredja Suhartono (Nexia) for FY2023-FY2024 (per AGMS results).

UNITS: all audited FS FY2019-FY2025 are in full Rupiah (divided by 1e9, full precision kept); the OJK published reports (9M2025, 9M2026) are in Rp juta (divided by 1,000). FS2020-FS2022 PDF pp. 5 and 7 (liabilities/equity and the second P&L page incl. EPS) are scanned images with no text layer; their values were read from the rendered pages (img/) and cross-checked with the AR financial highlights (AR2022 PDF p. 7: 2022/2021/2020 levels) and the next year's comparative columns.

LOSS YEARS ARE REAL: net loss Rp-70.6bn (2020: deferred-tax write-down of Rp89.5bn on a pre-tax profit of Rp18.9bn) and Rp-44.1bn (2021: Covid-era provisions); profit Rp16.6bn (2022), 48.8bn (2023), 78.8bn (2024), 48.3bn (2025), 72.7bn in 9M2026. Accumulated deficit (saldo laba tidak ditentukan penggunaannya) between Rp-446bn (2021) and Rp-254bn (2025) in every year-end FY2019-FY2025 - this is why no dividend was paid.

RATIOS OUTSIDE THE VALIDATOR RANGES ARE REAL: CAR 98.07 (2021), 127.42 (2022), 92.54 (2023), 88.58 (2024), 87.79 (2025), 83.52 (9M2026) - Bank of India injected Rp1tn (Dec 2021) and Rp1.3tn (Nov 2022) to lift core capital above the Rp3tn floor while the loan book stayed at Rp1.8-4.8tn. LAR 68.00% at Dec 2020 (AR2020 BoC report; pandemic restructuring). LDR 133-142% in 2023-2026 (loans funded by equity). All as printed by the bank, consistent across the AR ratio tables and the OJK published reports.

RATIO SOURCES / RESTATEMENTS: each FY's ROA, ROE, NIM, LDR, CIR, CAR, BOPO, NPL gross/net and CASA ('Dana Murah terhadap DPK') come from the 'Rasio Keuangan' table of that year's AR (first publication); FY2024 and FY2025 are identical to the Dec 2024 / Dec 2025 OJK published reports. Later documents restate some values: FY2023 CIR 40.03 -> 39.14 (Dec-2024 report, AR2024, AR2025); FY2024 NIM 4.63 -> 4.44, CIR 44.03 -> 44.09, BOPO 79.67 -> 79.71 (Dec-2025 report in the new SEOJK 29/2025 template, AR2025, Oct-2026 expose). AR2022's chart prints 2022 CASA 14.63 against 17.13 in its table (17.13 stored; matches the DPK breakdown). Older Dec published reports (2020-2023) are no longer on the IR page and were not used. ROA is pre-tax (OJK), ROE = net profit / average core capital. LAR has no table: FY2020-FY2024 values are narrative figures from the BoC/governance texts (AR2020 p. 18, AR2022 p. 61, AR2023 p. 2, AR2024 p. 13); FY2025 LAR, all CoC and all NPL coverage values are not disclosed (null). The 9M2026 LAR is the new OJK 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah (KKR)' line.

TRADING HISTORY (matters for the price file): IDX suspended BSWD in all markets on 12 Feb 2018 (the EGMS of 26 Mar 2018 approved a voluntary delisting at Bank of India's direction). The EGMS of 12 Dec 2023 cancelled the delisting and IDX lifted the suspension from session I of 18 Dec 2023 (AR2023 PDF pp. 10 and 96; AR2024 PDF p. 10). So there were NO trades from mid-Feb 2018 to 15 Dec 2023: the AR year-end 'closes' for 2019-2022 (Rp1,750) are the carried last price. Both rights issues (PUT IV ex 15 Aug 2022, PUT V ex 11 Apr 2023, each 1:1 at Rp1,000) happened inside that gap, i.e. between the FY2022 carried close (1,750) and the FY2023 close (1,245). The AR tables show a non-traded Nov-2023 'close' of Rp1,185, which equals the theoretical ex-rights price of 1,750 after two 1:1 rights at 1,000 (1,187.5 rounded to the tick) - my reading, not printed. After resumption trading is very thin (many months with no trades in 2024-2025). Per news (pasardana.id, kontan.co.id, Oct 2026), IDX suspended the stock again around 30 Sep/5 Oct 2026 after a >140% rise to Rp3,600, reopened it on 15 Oct 2026 and suspended it again from 21 Oct 2026 - news only, no company document; not used as data.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03: two rights issues only (PUT IV 2022-08-15 1:1 @Rp1,000; PUT V 2023-04-11 1:1 @Rp1,000), both with a numeric price. No split, reverse split, bonus issue or par-value change (nominal Rp200 since IPO; AR2024 PDF p. 10 and AR2025 PDF p. 7 state no corporate action in 2024 and 2025). The 2026 material-information letters (9 and 25 Mar 2026, EGMS 5 Mar 2026) concern management changes and article 17 (directors' powers) only; the incidental public expose of 8 Oct 2026 (slide 14) says no corporate action is planned. Earlier rights issues (PUT I 2008, PUT II Dec 2014-Jan 2015, PUT III Dec 2017 @Rp1,890) are before scope. Share count: 1,388,800,000 (2017-2021) -> 2,388,861,478 (2022) -> 3,688,866,845 (2023 onward). Since no rights or bonus issue has an ex-date before 2020-12-31, fy.2019.year_end_price is not required; it is stored anyway (Rp1,750, AR2019) for completeness.

PER-SHARE BASIS: there was never a split, so share_basis is simply each figure's period-end date. The FS compute basic EPS on the FY-end share count in 2022 and 2023 (labelled 'weighted average'), so EPS x FY-end shares = profit in every year and no eps_shares acknowledgement is needed. Book value per share is distorted at end-2021 and end-2022: equity includes Bank of India's capital deposits (Rp1.0tn and Rp1.3tn) for shares issued only in the following year.

DIVIDENDS: none out of FY2020-FY2025 profit (losses in 2020-2021; accumulated deficit throughout). AGMS decisions: 30 Jun 2021 (FY2020, AR2021 PDF p. 67), 28 Jun 2022 (FY2021), 27 Jun 2023 (FY2022), 27 Jun 2024 (FY2023), 24 Jun 2025 (FY2024), 24 Jun 2026 (FY2025) - all 'no dividend / profit retained'. payout_ratio = 0 for 2020-2025 with those sources; the dividends list is empty. (The validator warns 'no dividend records' for the profitable years 2022-2025; that is expected.)

INTERIM: 9M2026 (30 Sep 2026) from the OJK quarterly published report posted 29 Oct 2026 (unaudited); no full 9M interim FS on the IR page yet. The validator's 'YTD profit YoY +614%' warning is real: 9M2026 profit Rp72.7bn vs 9M2025 Rp10.2bn, when impairment charges fell from Rp109.2bn to Rp29.7bn (report PDF p. 3). Prior-year loans and deposits from the 30 Sep 2025 published report. Deposits are the sum of the printed giro + tabungan + deposito lines (no subtotal printed). CoC, NPL coverage and CASA are not in the 9M2026 documents (null).
KBMI: AR2025 PDF p. 124 (and AR2023/AR2024 PDF p. 107) classify the bank as KBMI 1; core capital Rp3.5tn at 30 Sep 2026.
